sideBranchFollowUps.$comment: Optional Q&A chips carried over from the rate-parity context. Keep only if the host wants them; not core to the campaign happy path.
sideBranchFollowUps.rootCause:
Root cause identified: OTA is undercutting.

The discrepancy originates from OTA-side pricing. Booking.com and Expedia are applying promotions not aligned with your configured rates. Brand.com rates are correctly configured in Salesforce.
sideBranchFollowUps.affectedReservations:
12 reservations affected

Guests who booked via OTA channels in the affected date ranges paid between 10-16% less than direct bookers. This represents approximately $2,380 in potential revenue leakage.
sideBranchFollowUps.priceCorrections:
Recommended corrections:

1. Contact Booking.com to disable unauthorized promotions on Jun 15-20
2. Update Expedia extranet to enforce rate parity clause
3. Set up automated rate parity monitoring alerts

Shall I draft the communication to the OTA account managers?
